pages.text: While sitting on a stool, the $(bold)lower half of your skin is replaced with your chosen skin color$() (the pants second layer disappears) — purely a client-side visual, and other players see it too.$(br2)Color: config screen → Visuals → eyedropper, pick one pixel from your own skin.

The first time you sit, a default skin color is sampled automatically; you can change it anytime.$(br2)If no skin loader is installed or the skin can't be fetched, it falls back to a default skin color.
